TABLE RELATIONSHIPS AND DESCRIPTION


- MAIN RELATIONSHIPS


  • Branch – Vehicle: 1:N
    A branch can have multiple vehicles (Vehicle.branchId)

  • Vehicle – Rental: 1:N
    A vehicle can be part of multiple rentals (Rental.vehicleId)

  • Client – Rental: 1:N
    A client can have multiple rentals (Rental.clientId)

  • Branch – Rental: 1:N
    A branch manages multiple rentals (Rental.branchId)

  • User – Rental: 1:N
    Users create and complete rentals (createdByUserId, completedByUserId)

  • User – RefreshToken / AuditLog / SecurityAlert: 1:N
    A user can have multiple associated records



- MAIN TABLES DESCRIPTION


  • Branch – represents company locations

  • Vehicle – stores vehicle information

  • Rental – records rental transactions

  • Client – stores customer data

  • User – system users (admin, manager, operator)



- USER ROLES


  • Administrator – manages the entire system

  • Manager – manages a specific branch

  • Operator – handles rental operations



- HELPER TABLES


  • RefreshToken – used for authentication

  • AuditLog – stores action history

  • SecurityAlert – stores security alerts



- ENUMERATIONS


  • VehicleCategory – vehicle types

  • VehicleStatus – vehicle states

  • RentalStatus – rental states

  • UserRole – user roles

  • AlertType – alert types
